title: A flaw was found in GIMP. Opening a crafted XCF with a truncated uncompressed tile can expose uninitialized…
description: A vulnerability in GIMP allows exposure of uninitialized stack memory when opening a crafted XCF file with a truncated uncompressed tile. This memory exposure can leak process addresses, potentially weakening Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) protections. The issue has a medium severity rating and requires user interaction to trigger.
